build_command: mkdir -p backend/frontend && cp -R frontend/. backend/frontend/ && cp -f role_case_task_dbeaver.sql backend/role_case_task_dbeaver.sql && (cp -R mood_img backend/mood_img 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp -R task_img backend/task_img 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp -R img backend/img 2>/dev/null || true)
start_command: if [ -f app/main.py ]; then uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT; else cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT; fi
